title: onprem: vendor offline bundles + rke2/k3s/rke support + helm chart pinning and upgrade tooling
author: Priya Nambiar
description:
Motivation: Customers running the Private (on-prem / air-gapped) installer reported friction supporting a wider set of Kubernetes distributions (RKE2, K3s, RKE) and doing fully offline installs. This PR adds automated offline bundle creation, vendors runtime dependencies used by the installer, pins third-party Helm chart dependencies for reproducible airgap installs, and extends the installer CLI + Terraform module to support distro overlays and safer upgrades/rollbacks.

What this change does: 
- New scripts to build an offline bundle (scripts/build-offline-bundle.sh) that collects container images, Helm charts and vendor files into a tarball suitable for air-gapped transfer.
- Vendors all external chart YAML and CRDs used by the private installer into vendor/charts/* and commits license metadata as required by security scan.
- Adds distribution overlays under examples/distro-overlays/{rke2,k3s,rke} with small manifest patches and systemd unit snippets required by those distros.
- Pins Helm chart dependency versions in charts/redwood-private/Chart.yaml and values in values.yaml to avoid floating upgrades in airgapped installs.
- Terraform module updates (terraform/modules/private-installer) exposing a new var vendor_bundle_path and lifecycle hooks for safe rollbacks.
- Installer CLI: new flags --offline-bundle and --distro to select vendor overlays at install time; also a new subcommand redwood-installer upgrade --preview to show actions before upgrade and an automatic rollback hook on failure.
- Add E2E smoke tests for RKE2/K3s in the perf-canary matrix and a minimal airgap acceptance test that runs in CI using a local kind cluster + mocked registry.

Compatibility and migration notes: 
- Backwards-compatible: if no --offline-bundle is provided, installer behavior is unchanged (still pulls images from registry).
- Existing customers using custom Helm values should test pinning; we provide a compatibility guide in docs/airgap.md.

Security & licensing: Security scan initially flagged a vendored dependency lacking a license header; added LICENSE metadata files for vendor charts and updated the audit-log-exporter packaging to include license scanning artifacts.

Testing: Unit tests for CLI parsing and Terraform plan outputs added. CI runs include: unit, lint, airgap-smoke, and distro-specific smoke tests. E2E RKE2 smoke initially flakes on node bootstrap in one run, flake fixed by adding a 10s readiness probe retry and the test passed on rerun.

Release considerations: This PR should be included in the next Private 0.9.0 patch release. Operators performing air-gapped upgrades should read docs/airgap.md; an example upgrade workflow is included in examples/upgrade-rollback/README.md.

release_notes:
- Add offline bundle builder for air-gapped installs (scripts/build-offline-bundle.sh)
- Vendor Helm charts and pin dependency versions for reproducible airgap installs
- Add distro overlays for RKE2, K3s, and RKE
- Terraform module: support vendor_bundle_path and safer upgrade lifecycle hooks
- Installer CLI: --offline-bundle, --distro, and upgrade --preview with automatic rollback on failure
- CI: new smoke tests for RKE2/K3s and an airgap acceptance test
